t: The Hillbrush Lobby Dustpan and Soft Angle Brush Set provides efficient cleaning for various professional environments. Constructed from durable polypropylene with soft polyester bristles, it is ideal for quick clean-ups in workshops, commercial kitchens, and other trade workplaces. The dustpan features a soft lip for effective debris collection on uneven floors, while the angled brush head improves reach around fixtures. Designed for practical use, the lightweight set ensures easy handling and convenient storage, with handles that clip together and a hangable design for tidy organisation of cleaning tools.

Angled Brush Head Improves Reach & Control
